Dwell Control-specific listing vocabulary — what translates differently

Dwell-to-click accessibility marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese buyers describe Dwell Control workflows — not a literal paste of US marketing:

Dwell Control vs Pointer Control vs Eye Tracking dwell

US pages use "Dwell Control", "Dwell to click", or "Pointer dwell." China storefront copy often uses 停留控制 for Apple's Dwell Control feature name, 停留点击 when emphasizing click-by-dwell, 悬停控制 for hover-and-dwell framing, or 指针停留 for pointer-rest activation — depending on whether you mean system Dwell Control, in-app dwell demos, or head tracking dwell. AppLocale aligns phrasing with your actual scope and avoids conflating Dwell Control with 指针控制 (Pointer Control tracking speed), 眼动追踪 (Eye Tracking gaze dwell), or 切换控制 (Switch Control) when your screenshots show dwell timing sliders, not speed sliders or calibration dots.

Dwell timing vs Touch Accommodations hold duration

Dwell timing (停留时间) controls how long the pointer must rest before activating a click. Touch Accommodations hold duration (触控调节) controls how long a finger must touch the screen — two distinct settings with different screenshot vocabulary. Do not reuse Touch Accommodations framing on pointer dwell highlight frames unless that is what the screenshot depicts.

Pointer dwell vs head tracking dwell

Pointer dwell uses mouse, trackpad, or on-screen pointer rest timing. Head tracking dwell uses head movement as the pointer source — related but distinct screenshot vocabulary. zh-Hans copy should name head tracking dwell only when your English listing and screenshots already claim it.

Dwell highlight rings vs Switch Control scanning

Dwell highlight rings show timed pointer rest before activation. Switch Control scanning highlights cycle through UI elements with external switch presses — a different surface. Do not reuse Switch Control framing on dwell ring demo frames unless that is what the screenshot shows.

Subtitle and keyword packing

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need dwell-control search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 停留控制, 停留点击, 悬停控制, and 指针停留 each signal different intent from Pointer Control, Eye Tracking, or Switch Control keywords.

Caption lines vs burned-in badges

Marketing screenshot overlays you control — "Dwell Control" headlines on gallery frames — are separate caption fields or burned-in PNG text. See Screenshot captions in Simplified Chinese for caption-field mechanics when overlays are editable in Connect.

Dwell Control feature launches and new dwell-to-click workflow updates often land in the 170-character promotional text field above the description — updatable without a new binary. See Promotional text in Simplified Chinese when your dwell-control pitch lives in promo text rather than the long description.

AppLocale FAQ

Does AppLocale implement Dwell Control APIs or dwell overlay code?

No. We deliver Connect listing metadata copy only — name, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text when included, and screenshot caption lines. Dwell Control OS integration, dwell timer UI engineering, pointer dwell highlight overlays, and Settings deep-link engineering are outside scope.

How is Dwell Control listing copy different from Pointer Control, Eye Tracking, or Switch Control?

Dwell Control listing copy covers dwell-to-click, dwell timing, pointer dwell, and head tracking dwell — activating actions after the pointer rests for a set time. Pointer Control covers tracking speed, scrolling speed, pointer size, and alternative pointer buttons for mouse and trackpad devices. Eye Tracking covers front-camera gaze calibration and dwell to select with your eyes. Switch Control covers external adaptive switch hardware and scanning. Those are different buyer stories with different screenshot vocabulary.

How is Dwell Control different from AssistiveTouch, Touch Accommodations, or Hover Text?

Dwell Control activates clicks after timed pointer rest. AssistiveTouch shows a floating on-screen assistive menu. Touch Accommodations tunes finger touch hold duration and tap assistance. Hover Text magnifies text near the pointer when hovering. If your English listing mentions multiple surfaces, zh-Hans copy should name each workflow accurately per screenshot frame.

How is this different from RTT, Voice Control, or Reachability?

RTT covers real-time text for phone call accessibility. Voice Control covers spoken UI commands. Reachability brings the top of the iPhone screen down for one-handed reach. Dwell Control covers pointer-rest dwell-to-click timing — a different framing on the product page.
